cover.headline: Inside the NRL's $5.3bn deal.
cover.deal: How the 2028 to 2034 rights deal is carved up

rows.sub: Runs to 2034, a record for Australian sport
Cash per year versus the current deal
Every game bar Origin and the grand final
Origin, grand final, three games a week
The league controls the schedule again
Foxtel gets an extra game if so

caption:
Australian sport's biggest media deal is $5.3 billion, and the split is the clever part.

From 2028 to 2034, Foxtel keeps nearly every NRL game, Nine keeps State of Origin and the grand final free, and Sky NZ gets 130+ games on its free platforms. Cash per year is up 90% on today's deal, and the league takes back control of the draw. A 20th club is on the cards, and DAZN is selling the NRL to 200 markets.
